en: The scuttlers of the Calm's first years, crawled up the hull-lines as the Calm fails: darker, with more wounds open.
A rasping hull-borer in the flotilla's keels. Its ribs armour it until they break.
Walk out along the dock to the dry-dock jetty.
Go aboard the hull on the last berth.
Go back aboard the hull. The others are waiting on deck.
Help Liss fit the hull's first lamp by the engine.
Go to the dock-master's house. Ysolde has spread her work over his table.
Board the hull when you are ready.
The dock-master is standing at an empty berth.
